description.value: Hotel 19 is a recently restored oceanfront hotel in Port Hardy operated by two local women who transformed a long-vacant historic building into a modern boutique property. All rooms include private decks with ocean views and a coffee bar, and an attached sushi restaurant serves guests on-site. The property is still undergoing phased renovations, with a basement pub planned as a future addition.

address.value: 7370 Market Street, Port Hardy, BC, Canada
